items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 22:1
items.html: Since every lower one is lower in degree than the upper one, it is found that when the upper one couples to emanate the stature of the lower one, it does not couple according to the discernment of the coarseness of its own screen, but according to a screen lesser than its own screen, which is regarded as the outer discernment relative to the stature of the screen higher than it. As above in Answer 73. (913, item 83).
